source.title: The Role of Early Bioelectric Signals in the Regeneration of Planarian Anterior/Posterior Polarity.

stage: trunk fragment (PT fragment, cut just behind pharynx and halfway to tail tip)
injury: two transverse amputations (posterior to pharynx; midway to tail tip)

intervention.description: Fragments soaked in 0.24 uM nigericin with 15 mM potassium gluconate for 3 h after amputation, then washed

readout.method: scoring for an eye at each pole
